meta.title: Returns and refunds
meta.description: Contraption Cart return policy: contact us and send the item back within 30 days of delivery. Returns and exchanges accepted. Buyer pays return postage.

blocks.text: This policy applies to Contraption Cart orders on www.contraptioncart.com, including change of mind and defective items.

blocks.content:
Policy URL
https://www.contraptioncart.com/returns
Countries
All countries we ship to. Returned items must be posted to Australia.
Returns accepted
Yes. I accept returns of physical items, including defective and non-defective (change of mind) orders.
Exchanges
Yes. I accept exchanges of physical items when a replacement is available. Otherwise I refund.
Product condition
Please return items in original condition. If an item is not returned in original condition, the buyer is responsible for loss in value as agreed with me.
Return window
30 days from delivery. You must contact me and send the item back within 30 days of delivery.
Window extension
None.
Return method
By mail. There is no in-store or drop-off return.
Return label
Customer responsibility. The buyer pays return postage costs.
Currency
AUD. Refunds go back through the original payment method where the provider allows.
Restocking fee
No restocking fee. If the item is not in original condition, any loss in value is agreed with the buyer before the refund is finalised.
Refund processing time
5 days after I receive and inspect the returned item.

How to start a return or exchange

No account or login is required. Email shasabolton@gmail.com within 30 days of delivery. Include your order number or PayPal transaction id, the product, and whether you want a return or an exchange.

I will confirm the return and give you the postal address in Sheffield, Tasmania, Australia. Pack the item securely, post it, and keep your tracking number. You must send the item back within 30 days of delivery.

Return window

Buyer must contact me and send the item back within 30 days of delivery. The window starts on the delivery date, not the order date.

Return costs

The buyer is responsible for return postage costs. Original outbound shipping is not refunded on change-of-mind returns.

If the item arrives damaged, is defective, or is not as described, I will cover return postage and refund the product price and original shipping.

Refunds

Approved returns are refunded to the original payment method. Processing takes 5 days after the parcel arrives and I have inspected it. Your bank or PayPal may take extra time to show the refund.

If an item is not returned in original condition, the buyer is responsible for loss in value as agreed with me before the refund is completed.

Exchanges

I accept exchanges of this item when a replacement is in stock. If it is not available, I will refund instead. The same 30-day window, return postage, and original-condition terms apply.

Digital downloads

Digital plans and downloadable files cannot be returned or exchanged once delivered, unless they are defective or not as described. In Google Merchant Center those products use the return policy label digital. Physical products use the default policy on this page.

Australian Consumer Law

Nothing in this policy limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
